sources.primary_title: IBM and Ejada Systems leverage IBM Bob to help accelerate Enterprise Modernization in Saudi Arabia
sources.verified_angle_summary: IBM and Ejada Systems announced a joint modernization initiative applying IBM Bob, an agentic software engineering platform, to accelerate enterprise modernization in Saudi Arabia. The project, evaluated across government, financial services, and telecommunications sectors, showed up to a 40% reduction in discovery effort and compressed analysis timelines from weeks to days. It demonstrated high effectiveness in reverse engineering (95%), architecture documentation (90%), and Java modernization (80%). The collaboration highlights a practical application of AI in enterprise transformation, particularly for modernizing complex legacy systems like COBOL applications, aligning with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 digital transformation goals. This specific angle focuses on the tangible, measured outcomes of deploying AI agents for software engineering in the region.
